title: Tuning Trouble
description: Find the first position where N consecutive characters are all unique.
writeup:
## Approach

Slide a window across the input string and check whether all characters in the window are unique using a set.

## Part 1

Find the first position where the last 4 characters are all distinct. This marks the start-of-packet.

## Part 2

Same approach but with a window of 14 characters for the start-of-message marker. The set-based uniqueness check keeps both parts simple and readable.
